definitions: An open-source WebRTC stack that provides real-time audio, video, and data communication capabilities for web and mobile applications.
A platform designed for building live interactive experiences, offering features like SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) for media routing, room management, and client SDKs.
examples: LiveKit powers the video conferencing feature in our app.
Developers can integrate LiveKit into their applications for real-time communication.
The latest version of LiveKit includes improved performance.
